name: How much does professional house fire cleanup cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional house fire cleanup cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional house fire cleanup varies widely depending on the scale of the damage, the size of the affected areas, and the specific services required (e.g., contents cleaning, structural repairs, deodorization). Restoration companies typically provide an estimate after a thorough on-site inspection. Most homeowners' insurance policies cover fire damage restoration, so it's advisable to contact your insurer promptly to understand your coverage and claim process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on damage severity and services needed; an on-site estimate is required. Homeowners' insurance often covers fire damage.
